messages.subject: Re: clarification request w.r.t. RSNNS/MLP - regression
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

an example is, e.g., the "iris" demo in the package:

https://github.com/cbergmeir/RSNNS/blob/master/RSNNS/demo/iris.R

If your model performs better in training than in testing this means
that you are overfitting. You should try using less hidden units then,
for example.

Regards,
Christoph

messages.subject: questions about RSNNS - convergence & architecture
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,

I’m using the R package of SNNS in some academic experiments, and I have a couple of questions regarding convergence and network architecture that I can’t find answers to in manual:

- Can the package detect convergence at the moment? If so, how can I see the total number of epochs run before convergence?
- If the problem is linearly separable and I don’t want to use any hidden nodes, can I set the parameter of “size” to 0?

Many thanks for your help.

Mengxi

messages.subject: Re: questions about RSNNS - convergence & architecture
messages.body_plain:
Dear Michelle,

> - Can the package detect convergence at the moment? If so, how can I see the total number of epochs run before convergence?

No, the package doesn't detect convergence at the moment, you'd have to implement this yourself.

> - If the problem is linearly separable and I don’t want to use any hidden nodes, can I set the parameter of “size” to 0?

Good question, have you tried what happens?

Regards,
Christoph
